title: Accurate and Efficient Multi-Channel Time Series Forecasting via Sparse Attention Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2603.18712v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The task of multi-channel time series forecasting is ubiquitous in numerous fields such as finance, supply chain management, and energy planning. It is critical to effectively capture complex dynamic dependencies within and between channels for accurate predictions. However, traditional method paid few attentions on learning the interaction among channels. This paper proposes Linear-Network (Li-Net), a novel architecture designed for multi-channel time series forecasting that captures the linear and non-linear dependencies among channels. Li-Net dynamically compresses representations across sequence and channel dimensions, processes the information through a configurable non-linear module and subsequently reconstructs the forecasts. Moreover, Li-Net integrates a sparse Top-K Softmax attention mechanism within a multi-scale projection framework to address these challenges. translated_title: 基于稀疏注意力机制的准确高效多通道时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 多通道时间序列预测任务在金融、供应链管理和能源规划等众多领域中普遍存在。有效捕获通道内部和通道之间的复杂动态依赖关系对于准确预测至关重要。然而，传统方法很少关注通道之间交互的学习。本文提出了线性网络，这是一种为多通道时间序列预测设计的新型架构，能够捕获通道之间的线性和非线性依赖关系。Li-Net 动态压缩序列维度和通道维度上的表示，通过可配置的非线性模块处理信息，随后重构预测结果。此外，Li-Net 在多尺度投影框架内集成了稀疏 Top-K Softmax 注意力机制以应对这些挑战。其核心创新在于能够无缝地融合……
tldr: 本文提出了Li-Net新型架构，通过稀疏Top-K Softmax注意力机制与多尺度投影框架，高效捕获多通道时间序列中通道间的线性和非线性依赖关系，实现准确且高效的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Li-Net, a novel architecture that integrates a sparse Top-K Softmax attention mechanism within a multi-scale projection framework to efficiently capture linear and non-linear dependencies among channels, enabling accurate and efficient multi-channel time series forecasting.
